questions.question: When a sinful woman heard Jesus was eating at a Pharisee's house, what did she bring with her?
In Jesus' story of a moneylender who forgave two debtors, which debtor did Simon say would love the moneylender more?

answers.text: The one who was forgiven more
The one who was forgiven less
Both of them about the same

questions.question: Jesus told Simon the Pharisee that a sinful woman's many sins were forgiven because of what?
Joanna, Susanna and many other women traveled with Jesus and the Twelve. How did these women help?

answers.text: Providing for the group from their own resources
Sending word ahead to each new town
Teaching the crowds in each village
